McKinney Chupacabras FC is McKinney’s premier pre-professional soccer club, founded in 2024 and competing in USL League Two. The team plays at Ron Poe Stadium, bringing high-quality, family-friendly soccer to the community. Guided by a strong “Community First” mission, the Chupacabras actively support local businesses, youth development programs, and civic initiatives. The club provides opportunities for athletes and young professionals to grow both on and off the field, contributing to McKinney’s dynamic and expanding community. As proud members of the McKinney Chamber of Commerce, McKinney Chupacabras FC is committed to strengthening connections and enriching the local economy.

Emerson is a global technology and engineering company providing innovative solutions for customers in industrial, commercial, and residential markets. Emerson is a Fortune 500 company with $14.5 billion in sales and 155 manufacturing locations worldwide. Our Emerson Automation Solutions business helps process, hybrid, and discrete manufacturers maximize production, protect personnel and the environment while optimizing their energy and operating costs. Our Emerson Commercial and Residential Solutions business helps ensure human comfort and health, protect food quality and safety, advance energy efficiency, and create sustainable infrastructure. Emerson has been a longtime investor in the McKinney community.
